If the low pets HP warning is enabled then this option will allow you to toggle the warning for your summons.

Shows an arrow bouncing over the head of the mobile connected to the healthbar under your mouse pointer.

If enabled this option allows you to close healthbars by right-clicking them.
Note: This option will also disable the context menu on the healthbars.
Enable Right-Click to Close Healthbars (Pets ONLY)

If enabled this option allows you to close a pet's healthbar by right-clicking it.
Note: This option will also disable the context menu on a pet's healthbar.
Show Close and Extract Buttons on Healthbars

Shows the Close and Extract button on healthbars.
If disabled, you can use CTRL + CLICK to extract the healthbars and ALT + CLICK to close them.
Show Word of Death Buttons on Healthbars

When enabled a button for Word of Death will appear on healthbars when the life percentage is at the right level based on your spellweaving skill level and your arcane circle level.
You must have enough spellweaving to cast the Word of Death spell in order to see this button.
Toggles the overhead spells text.  Disabling this allows you to cast spells without any words of power or spell names.
Toggles spell names near the spell's words of power.
If enabled you will see messages related to poison for others.
Toggles the War/Peace shield button.  If the button is removed you may use the War/Peace action to achieve the same results.
